description: Draws the largest institutional holders of a stock or ETF in the chat as an interactive table from 13F filings, with each holder's change and a way into its portfolio. Call it when the user asks who holds a stock, or when that list is itself the answer. Show at most one card per answer. Never call it to collect data for your own analysis: where the chat app draws cards it answers with one line, not the rows. GetTopHolders returns the figures.

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: the latest available).

name: ShowTopHolders
title: Show Top Holders
